name: Tharsigan Gnanasekar
headline: Software Engineering undergraduate | Salesforce ☁️ Enthusiast | 4x Salesforce Certified | AIESECer | Emerging Leader | Aspiring Project Manager

sections.position: Team Leader - iGT B2B @ AIESEC in Sri Lanka
sections.bio:
I am a driven individual with a strong passion for technology and education. After completing my A/Ls in Physical Science at Jaffna Hindu College with A2B results, I am now pursuing Software Engineering at the University of Sri Jayewardenepura.

With a solid foundation in Java, C, C++, and Python, I enjoy building logical solutions and continuously expanding my technical skillset. I am fluent in English and Tamil, enabling me to engage and collaborate in diverse environments.

Previously, I served as Lead Supervisor at New Science World, where I honed my leadership and organizational abilities. I also conducted personal classes to support and inspire fellow learners — a role that strengthened my commitment to education and mentoring.

I actively contribute to AIESEC, holding positions such as Team Leader in iCX Synergy, Member in IM & Analysis, Member in B2B, where I develop teamwork, communication, and strategic planning skills.

Currently, I am actively exploring the Salesforce ecosystem, focusing on how its capabilities can be used to drive innovation, enhance productivity, and streamline business processes.

I am always eager to learn, connect, and collaborate on meaningful initiatives that create impact.

posts.text:
I’m proud to share that I’ve achieved Agentblazer Legend ’26 🚀

This milestone means a lot to me, especially because it wasn’t an easy journey. In 2025, I aimed to reach this level within the Salesforce ecosystem but couldn’t make it due to not clearing the Agentforce Specialist Certification at the time.

Instead of stopping there, I took it as motivation. In 2026, I came back stronger, put in consistent effort, successfully earned the Agentforce Specialist Certification, and finally achieved Agentblazer Legend ’26.

This journey taught me the value of persistence, resilience, and continuous learning.

A big thank you to Yarl Salesforce Ohana, my mentors, and friends who supported and guided me throughout this journey. Your encouragement made a real difference.

Looking forward to achieving more milestones ahead! 💡
Trailhead 

#Salesforce #Agentblazer #Certification #LearningJourney #GrowthMindset #TrailblazerCommunity #YSFO

Excited to share that I’m attending the Salesforce Headless 360 Community Tour, a global community initiative bringing the next generation of digital experiences right to our doorstep.

This hands-on workshop is a great opportunity to explore the evolving Salesforce ecosystem, gain practical insights, and connect with fellow Trailblazers in the community. Looking forward to learning more about Headless architecture and how it shapes modern digital solutions.

A big thank you to Yarl Salesforce Ohana for organizing this valuable event and continuously supporting the learning journey of aspiring professionals like us.
Trailhead 

#Salesforce #TrailblazerCommunity #Headless360 #YSFO #Learning #TechCommunity #Jaffna #CareerGrowth #SalesforceSaturday

Thank you so much for the recognition! 🙏

Grateful to KnowledgeHub by YSFO for the support and guidance throughout this journey. This certification is a great step forward in my Salesforce and MuleSoft learning path.

Looking forward to achieving more milestones ahead! 🚀

🎉 Excited to share that I have successfully earned the Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Integration Foundations certification!

This milestone has strengthened my understanding of integration concepts and MuleSoft fundamentals, and it marks another step forward in my journey in the Salesforce ecosystem.

A big thank you to Yarl Salesforce Ohana for the continuous support and guidance throughout this journey.
Special appreciation to Ravindran Dhanushkar for the clear explanations and to Anuran R. for sharing valuable experience.

Also grateful to Knowledge Hub, which played a key role in helping me prepare effectively.

Looking forward to applying these learnings and exploring more in the world of integrations and APIs 🚀
Trailhead 

#Salesforce #MuleSoft #Integration #LearningJourney #Trailhead #Certification #FutureReady #YSFO

Celebrating 20 Years of the Trailblazer Community! 🎉

My journey started unexpectedly in 2024 when I accidentally attended Yarl Dreamin’24. That one event inspired me in ways I never imagined.

After that, I came across a flyer for a community event by Yarl Salesforce Ohana and decided to join. From that moment, everything changed. I started building connections, gained confidence, and became part of something truly meaningful.

Even when my Software Engineering degree at University of Sri Jayewardenepura began, I stayed connected to the community by attending sessions online — simply because of the passion and attachment I had developed.

Today, I’ve earned 3 certificates in Salesforce, all thanks to the continuous support and guidance from this amazing community.

Grateful to our leaders ThiriyambagaSarma Sothinathan ☁️ , Nanthavarman Lingeswaran, Jean Brenda Soundaralingam, Thaksaayaney Suntharamoorthy, Pirashanth Sithamparanadesan, and everyone who has been part of this journey — for believing in us and building a space where people truly grow.

Happy 20 years to the Trailblazer Community. Here's to the people who make it feel like family.
Trailhead 

#TrailblazerCommunityStories #TrailblazerCommunity #Salesforce #YarlSFO #Trailhead
